metadata.name: Free Flesh Door
metadata.description:
Mom's flesh door, your way.
- Beat Mom on Mausoleum/Gehenna II and you get the Knife Pieces you're missing. Walk into the flesh door and it opens like vanilla. - Keep the knife (ON by default): opening the door doesn't use the pieces up. The knife stays with you.
- The door has to be unlocked on your save first. - Off during the Ascent and in Greed mode.
Mod Config Menu (optional): Free Flesh Door ON/OFF and Keep the knife ON/OFF.
